statistic: the bounding-box overlap ratio a_o = area(Bp n Bgt) / area(Bp u Bgt) — intersection over union, IoU — which decides whether a detection counts as correct. Unlike the other three thresholds this instrument has read, it is not a statistic computed on data but a stipulation of an evaluation protocol; and this literature writes the same threshold in two units, 0.5 and 50%, which is why the profile carries focus_equivalents (instrument 0.4).
deriving_document: Everingham, M., Van Gool, L., Williams, C. K. I., Winn, J. & Zisserman, A. (2010), 'The PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) Challenge', International Journal of Computer Vision 88(2), 303-338, doi:10.1007/s11263-009-0275-7, section 4.2 'Bounding box evaluation'. Read at source 2026-08-08 (https://homepages.inf.ed.ac.uk/ckiw/postscript/ijcv_voc09.pdf, sha256 bda24d6d51d58815b6816cb483394356f692d897002c280014fa4fd4bbdc72cd, pdftotext 24.02.0 -layout, quotations checked against the PDF): 'To be considered a correct detection, the area of overlap ao between the predicted bounding box Bp and ground truth bounding box Bgt must exceed 0.5 (50%) by the formula [...]' followed immediately by the reason: 'The threshold of 50% was set deliberately low to account for inaccuracies in bounding boxes in the ground truth data, for example defining the bounding box for a highly non-convex object, e.g. a person with arms and legs spread, is somewhat subjective.'
provenance_note: The warrant here is unusually complete, which is the point of choosing it. The deriving document states the number, states the reason (annotation noise), names the limitation (box subjectivity), and then MEASURES ITS OWN THRESHOLD'S SENSITIVITY in section 6.2.3 'Evaluation of the overlap threshold': 'We evaluated the effect the overlap threshold has on the measured AP by varying the threshold [...] the measured AP drops steeply for thresholds above 50%, indicating that none of the methods give highly accurate bounding box predictions.' A stated reason, a named limitation and a published sensitivity analysis: the question is whether any of it travels. LIMIT ON THE ATTRIBUTION, recorded before the count: the 0.5 criterion is older than this paper — it was already the rule of the VOC challenges of 2005-2007 whose results the paper reports. This is the document that states criterion, formula, justification and sensitivity together and that the citing literature can cite; it is not claimed as the number's first appearance, and no count rests on that claim.

site_rejects.name: mean-form
site_rejects.note: P-C, tick 58. A mean over classes or images is a reported score; the criterion in this literature is stated on the per-detection IoU and never on its average. Pinned to twelve papers of the tick-56/57 census, where EVERY matched string carrying a mean form was hand-read as no threshold statement at all — `mIoU of 89.04%`, `mIoU of 72.47%`, `mIoU (SS) of 50.9`, `mIoU=0.92`, and the four notation cases. The `unless` is what keeps the one apparent counter-example, which is not one: `IoU (mIoU) and instance-level average precision (AP) at IoU thresholds of 25%` reaches its value from `IoU thresholds`, not from the mean.

cite_voc.note: the deriving document, named in a citation key standing in the window. Scope is the cite keys ONLY, because 'PASCAL VOC' in prose is the name of a dataset, not of the document that derived the number — the distinction this case turns on.

name_voc_dataset.note: the dataset name in prose. A site can carry the name and not the document; that is the whole shape of this line's claim, and here it is separately countable.

cite_coco.note: a citation key pointing at MS COCO, which ADOPTED the 0.5 threshold as one point of its averaged band rather than deriving it

cite_detector.note: a citation key pointing at a detector paper — a method that used the threshold, not a document that derived it

cite_iouloss.note: a citation key pointing at the IoU-as-loss literature, where IoU is an objective rather than a criterion

software.note: a toolkit standing where a document might have — the threshold arriving as a default

hedge.note: a hedge word doing the work a citation would do — 'the standard threshold of 0.5'

as_iou.note: the site names the quantity IoU

as_overlap.note: the site names it overlap, as the deriving document does

as_jaccard.note: the site names it after Jaccard — an eponym older than any of these documents
